title: Mixed Sizes Without Cropping
tests: Checks consistent vertical composition of landscape, square and portrait photos without cropping or distortion.

faults.what: The storefront is enlarged to fill the vertical frame, cutting off substantial portions of both sides instead of preserving the complete landscape photo.
The square latte photo is cropped on both sides; even the cup handle is cut off.
The output uses full-frame cropped photos rather than fitted whole photos with soft blurred background fill.

judge.summary: The 10-second vertical reel has no visible added text, but it crops the photos to fill the frame instead of preserving them over blurred backgrounds.

must_haves.item: One silent 9:16 reel runs for approximately 10 seconds with no added text.
must_haves.why: The supplied clip is 10 seconds long, its frames are 9:16, and no added text is visible; the reported -91 dB peak is effectively silent despite the conflicting speech transcription.

must_haves.item: All five supplied photos appear in the requested order.
must_haves.why: The samples show storefront, latte, barista and interior in the expected relative order, but no sampled frame shows pastries; its presence between samples cannot be confirmed or ruled out.

must_haves.item: The landscape storefront, barista and interior photos retain their complete image boundaries.
must_haves.why: The storefront visibly loses large areas from both sides compared with the supplied original. The barista and interior also fill the vertical canvas, but their original attachments are not shown for direct comparison.

must_haves.item: The square latte and vertical pastries photos also remain fully visible, without cropping.
must_haves.why: The latte clearly loses its left and right image boundaries, including part of its handle. Pastries is not shown in the sampled output frames.

must_haves.item: Every foreground photo retains its original proportions, with no stretching or squashing.
must_haves.why: The visible storefront and latte appear proportionally enlarged rather than stretched, but the pastries output and the original barista and interior images are unavailable for comparison.

must_haves.item: Unused canvas around fitted photos is filled with a soft blurred background rather than plain bars.
must_haves.why: No fitted foreground photos or surrounding blurred fill are visible; the photos are instead enlarged and cropped edge to edge.
